fun.reason: Quick loop and strong finale; middle months felt samey because I just approved picks.

clarity.reason: Goal bar and this-month chip told me what to do; a few contradictions in tags and end pages.

visual.reason: Broadcast scenes and globe look crafted; debrief card clips on a small laptop.
